[P1] Allow saved callback IDs during completed-child reconstruction

If a map/parallel branch completes a large-result child with `ReplayChildren`, then suspends and resumes within the same invocation, this terminal-only exception rejects the child's existing `STARTED` callback. However, `create_callback()` only reads its saved callback ID. The resulting `OrphanedChildException` makes the coordinator exit and checkpoint a successful batch with the resumed branch's result missing. Allow replay admission for existing callback checkpoints while retaining the guard against new callback creation, and add this case to the same-invocation replay tests.
